args.query: drought monitor state percent area D0 D1 New Hampshire

sql: SELECT week_date, AVG(none_pct) AS none_avg, AVG(d0_pct) AS d0, AVG(d1_pct) AS d1, AVG(d2_pct) AS d2, COUNT(*) n FROM weather.drought_monitor_weekly WHERE state_abbr='NH' AND week_date >= '2026-10-20' GROUP BY week_date ORDER BY week_date
